name: mod-mmhmm
about: mods/mmhmm's Mm-hmm! hat bonus: rare hats from the kit verb get it exactly when they qualify (25 %, a function of the item), on top of their rolled modifiers; a common hat never; the worn hat with it counts crits while a pistol shoots a target dummy (bench). Then in a run, with the hat: the last orb of a 3-orb tree voices it once, not its first orb nor a 1-orb tree; a well and a secret room (their run stats, gl statadd) and a real Ace chest (mods/keys) once each; the 4th piece of Charms of Fortune, not the 3rd; nothing once the hat is off. The voice goes through the host to every peer ([HWP:mmhmm] voice: <why>); GameLab is muted, so the sound is not measured, and a real revive needs two players (covered: the corpse is HWPMmHmmCorpse and cht_revive, which has no other reviver, stays quiet). Uses levelup, kit, give, orb and trinket cheats: not evidence of play.
